stories.headline: OpenAI uses its models to improve semiconductor chip design
stories.script: Our lead story today. OpenAI has described how its models have helped engineers improve its Jalapeño custom inference chip and work on third-party hardware. One reported multiplier redesign reduced cell area by approximately 15% while reducing latency from two clock cycles to one. OpenAI says further design improvements have been silicon-proven. The company is also working with Synopsys to integrate frontier AI models with electronic design automation tools. Why it matters: AI is beginning to assist in designing the very hardware required to run advanced AI. This could accelerate chip engineering and improve computing efficiency.

stories.headline: Lagarde says EU funds should take first losses on chip plants, data centers
stories.script: Turning to the United States. European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said on Friday that public money from the European Union should absorb the first losses on large chip-plant and data-center projects, as a way to draw in private investment, CNBC reports. Speaking at the Frankfurt European Banking Congress, in her last address there before leaving the ECB in February, Lagarde said that where a challenge needs a European answer, the institutions able to deliver it should be reinforced. In technology, she argued, projects requiring European scale call for public-private partnerships at the European level, with public funds, including the EU budget, "taking the first losses and drawing in private capital." Lagarde has warned before that Europe lacks the data center capacity to meet its own needs, and that current plans for up to seven gigafactories across the European Union fall short.

stories.headline: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
stories.script: Around the world. Seven people who walked away from OpenAI in 2021 to found Anthropic are hours from becoming multi-billionaires, at least on paper, the BBC reports. The company, which makes the AI platform Claude, has grown in only five years from an obscure start-up into a technology heavyweight valued at more than a trillion dollars. Anthropic is now listing on the US stock market, with its shares priced in a range of 70 dollars to 78. dollars Should the offering land at the top of that band, each founder's stake would be worth no less than 18.5 billion dollars . All seven are in their thirties or forties. Among them is Dario Amodei, who in 2020 was employed at OpenAI. That firm went on to introduce generative artificial intelligence to the general public with the launch of ChatGPT.
stories.whyThisMatters: Seven people who walked away from OpenAI in 2021 to found Anthropic are hours from becoming multi-billionaires, at least on paper, the BBC reports.

It covers trusted cross-border data-transfer mechanisms, joint investigation and enforcement, and technical cooperation on protecting privacy in the AI era.

stories.headline: Soket AI launches EKA-1 foundation model with 4 million dollar backing
stories.script: Turning to India. Soket AI has launched EKA-1, an open foundation model designed for mathematical reasoning, coding, and logical tasks across more than 100 Indian and Global South languages. The 26-billion parameter architecture is trained to handle regional linguistic nuances while maintaining competitive performance against global frontier models. The launch is backed by four million dollars in seed funding led by Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies, accelerating domestic development of multilingual AI infrastructure across the country.

stories.headline: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
stories.script: Around the world. Washington's latest export controls could put the brakes on Southeast Asia's rapid build-out of data centers, CNBC reports. Under an interim rule the Commerce Department issued on Monday, data centers based in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia must now obtain a license from the US government before buying advanced artificial intelligence chips, Nvidia's among them. Operators whose facilities already host large Chinese clients have 90 days to seek that license, or they risk export restrictions down the line. The measure takes aim at the region's growing function as a supplier of computing power to companies from China. Construction of data centers across Southeast Asia has climbed sharply, driven by demand for the semiconductors used to train and build AI models.

stories.headline: Visa expands its Agentic Ready programme across Asia-Pacific
stories.script: In other news. Visa is expanding its Agentic Ready programme to include more than 50 payment acquirers, service providers, gateways and selected merchants across Asia-Pacific. The programme will test how merchants recognise trusted AI agents and support agent-led product discovery, checkout, payment and post-purchase services. Why it matters: AI agents are moving from recommending products towards completing purchases. Payment networks are now preparing the infrastructure needed to authenticate and process transactions initiated by AI.
stories.whyThisMatters: Visa is expanding its Agentic Ready programme to include more than 50 payment acquirers, service providers, gateways and selected merchants across Asia-Pacific.

stories.headline: Bengaluru Tech Summit concludes with AI skilling and global partnerships
stories.script: Next. The Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 concluded with technology partnerships involving Poland, the UAE and France. Karnataka also announced an AI skilling initiative with Sarvam AI, targeting 2,000 students through a proposed AI lab in North Karnataka. A dedicated drone testing facility is also being developed in Chikkaballapur. Why it matters: This connects AI infrastructure and innovation with the development of local talent. India's AI competitiveness will depend not only on companies and models, but also on skilled people and facilities that allow new technologies to be tested and deployed. moneycontrol.com
stories.whyThisMatters: The Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 concluded with technology partnerships involving Poland, the UAE and France.
keyPoints: Bengaluru Tech Summit concludes with AI skilling and global partnerships

stories.headline: Apple releases FastFrames, an interactive-latency video-generation model
stories.script: Elsewhere. Apple has released FastFrames-L (14 billion parameters) and FastFrames-S (1.3 billion parameters), models designed to generate 480p video with interactive latency. Apple has also released an optimised LingBot model for camera-conditioned control, reporting a 16-times speed improvement over the original version. Why it matters: Faster video generation could move AI video beyond conventional prompt-and-wait workflows towards more interactive creative applications.
